content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Psychologist: M.A/M.Sc. Degree in Psychology from a recognized Institute/University (60% or above) with 5 Years' working experience with the Physically challenged in a Rehabilitation Centre. Desirable: M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 35 years Age relaxation is admissible in respect of SC/ST/OBC/PWBD candidates as per Government rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Psychologist Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Psychologist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Psychologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Psychologist recruitment is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Psychologist post is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Psychologist position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A/M.Sc. Degree in Psychology from a recognized university with at least 60% marks and 5 years of working experience with the physically challenged in a rehabilitation center. An M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhubaneswar has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Psychologist.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar, Odisha - 751019.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
